warnings: Spread footings on soil, no piles: F1 1.00 x 1.00 x 0.25 with 6+6-DB12; F2 1.30 x 1.30 x 0.30 with 8+8-DB12; both RB 9 รัดรอบ, top 1.00 below ระดับดินเดิม, 0.05 lean concrete 1:3:5 and 0.05 compacted sand. main_bar.count is the two-way total.
The column C1 runs down to each footing with its ties; no separate pedestal size is printed, so no pedestal fields.

PS precast-plank detail: the RB6@0.20 / wiremesh topping layer and the L/4 top bars over the interior beam are read from the drawing; the second additional_bars entry is a reading of the drawn top-bar layer and carries a flag. The 200 kg/m2 live load agrees with the A-01 notes.
